verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents self-hosting as a single binary with no external dependencies, runnable on your own machines or containers. That keeps indexed data under the user's control rather than the vendor's, which indirectly guards against it being used for AI training. The evidence contains no explicit no-training policy or training opt-out, and auto-generated embeddings via configured embedders may send documents to outside providers. missing for 10: an explicit vendor policy or contractual commitment that customer data (including Meilisearch Cloud data) is not used to train AI models, documented controls over third-party embedder data use, independent corroboration.
